description: EMC research discovery catalogue — screening in progress

expanded.query: ("extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma" OR "extra-skeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma" OR "extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcomas" OR "EWSR1-NR4A3" OR "TAF15-NR4A3" OR "EWS-CHN" OR "EWS-TEC")

med_title_abstract.query: SRC:MED AND (TITLE_ABS:"extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma" OR TITLE_ABS:"extra-skeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma")

med_title.query: SRC:MED AND (TITLE:"extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma" OR TITLE:"extra-skeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma")

crossref_title.note: Fuzzy relevance search; total-results is not an EMC count. Only disease/fusion title matches from the first 1000 results are included.

pubmed_exact_phrase.note: All 447 PubMed identifiers were retrieved and matched to catalogue records; no additional records from this exact-phrase query.

historical_models.query: ("H-EMC-SS" OR "HEMCSS" OR "hTAFII68-TEC" OR "hTAF(II)68-TEC" OR "TAF2N-TEC" OR "EWS-NOR1" OR "CHN-EWS")
historical_models.note: Historical model and fusion names; model identity and incidental mentions require adjudication.

limitations: Discovery records, not adjudicated EMC studies.
Conference coverage is incomplete; supplements, posters, datasets and unindexed outputs require separate searches.
DOI/identifier deduplication does not deduplicate studies, overlapping cohorts or preprint versions.
A free link is index metadata, not a successful full-text retrieval or reading.
Access unresolved never means no public version exists.
Full-text mention matches can be incidental; title matches can still be mimics or differential diagnoses.
